actions_taken:
Root cause analysis: The '0 proposals' observation was produced by an entity-graph binary compiled before commits c39b57e/f00d612 that decoupled proposal extraction from director extraction. Live testing confirmed the current code (with those fixes) correctly extracts 4 proposals each from the ABBV 2025 and ABBV 2026 proxy 8-Ks (seq=62737 and seq=62741) that were in the batch.

Newly identified gap: 'William H.L. Burnside' (ABBV 2025 proxy) was missing from director results. Root cause: reDirectorRow used (?:\s+[A-Z]\.)*  which requires a space before each initial. Compound initials like 'H.L.' (no space between H. and L.) failed the pattern.

Fix: Changed (?:\s+[A-Z]\.)*  to (?:\s+[A-Z](?:\.[A-Z])*\.)* in both reDirectorRow and reDirectorRow3Col. The new pattern handles 'H.L.' as a single unit (one space before the compound) while single-spaced initials like 'H. L.' or 'C.' continue to match unchanged.

Test added: TestParseItem507_CompoundInitials covers ABBV 2025 proxy text with William H.L. Burnside, Thomas C. Freyman, Brett J. Hart, plus 2 proposals. All 3 directors and both proposals must be extracted.

All tests pass (go test ./...).
notes: The '0 proposals' observation gap was already addressed by prior commits (c39b57e, f00d612). The entity-graph binary that produced the observation was running old code. The fix in this run closes the remaining director-name parsing gap for compound initials. The entity-graph will pick up the compound-initial fix on the next restart.
